description: OeS 6 supports engineering calculations for radial and meshed electricity networks. It includes load flow, short-circuit analysis and equipment data, with motor starting, harmonics and protection functions depending on the edition. The provider is IPC. Coverage: Coverage is user-defined high-, medium- and low-voltage networks. BASIC, PROF and EXPERT editions have different functions; the page does not specify a universal system-size limit. Access: The official Polish product and licensing description was read. No licence, trial or software package was requested. Licence and cost: The provider offers paid timed licences, quotes prices on request and describes a noncommercial EDU licence. The cable-capacity module is a separately paid option. Limitations: Features depend on the licensed edition and modules. Numerical accuracy and suitability for a particular network were not tested. For simulation it provides network calculation and protection-setting tools. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this named OeS edition.
